arxiv-2003-07797.title: Hyperplane Arrangements of Trained ConvNets Are Biased
arxiv-2003-07797.creator: Matteo Gamba, Stefan Carlsson, Hossein Azizpour, Mårten Björkman, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
arxiv-2003-07797.description: Abstract We investigate the geometric properties of the functions learned by trained ConvNets in the preactivation space of their convolutional layers, by performing an empirical study of hyperplane arrangements induced by a convolutional layer. We introduce statistics over the weights of a trained network to study local arrangements and relate them to the training dynamics.

arxiv-2105-09824.title: Lookahead Acquisition Functions for Finite-Horizon Time-Dependent Bayesian Optimization and Application to Quantum Optimal Control
arxiv-2105-09824.creator: S. Ashwin Renganathan, Jeffrey Larson, Stefan M. Wild
arxiv-2105-09824.description: Abstract We propose a novel Bayesian method to solve the maximization of a time-dependent expensive-to-evaluate stochastic oracle. We are interested in the decision that maximizes the oracle at a finite time horizon, given a limited budget of noisy evaluations of the oracle that can be performed before the horizon.

arxiv-2110-11016.title: Nonreciprocal phonon blockade
arxiv-2110-11016.creator: Xiao-Yu Yao, Hamad Ali, Peng-Bo Li
arxiv-2110-11016.description: Abstract Quantum nonreciprocal devices have received extensive attention in recent years because they can be used to realize unidirectional quantum routing and noise isolation. In this work, we show that the shift of resonance frequencies of propagating phonons induced by spin-orbit interactions (SOI) of phonons in a rotating acoustic ring cavity can be used to realize nonreciprocal phonon blockade.

arxiv-2205-01180.title: Using Machine Learning to Evaluate Real Estate Prices Using Location Big Data
arxiv-2205-01180.creator: Walter Coleman, Ben Johann, Nicholas Pasternak, Jaya Vellayan, Natasha Foutz, and Heman Shakeri
arxiv-2205-01180.description: Abstract With everyone trying to enter the real estate market nowadays, knowing the proper valuations for residential and commercial properties has become crucial. Past researchers have been known to utilize static real estate data (e.g. number of beds, baths, square footage) or even a combination of real estate and demographic information to predict property prices.

arxiv-2307-15182.title: Revisiting the mass of open clusters with Gaia data 2023 Revisiting the mass of open clusters with Gaia data – 4
arxiv-2307-15182.creator: Anderson Almeida, Hektor Monteiro, Wilton S. Dias
arxiv-2307-15182.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anderson Almeida, Hektor Monteiro, Wilton S. Dias. The publication of the Gaia catalogue and improvements in methods to determine memberships and fundamental parameters of open clusters has led to major advances in recent years. However, important parameters such as the masses of these objects, although being studied mostly in some isolated cases, have not been addressed in large homogeneous samples based on Gaia data, taking into account details such as binary fractions.

arxiv-2406-02715.title: Gravitational-Wave Data Analysis with High-Precision Numerical Relativity Simulations of Boson Star Mergers
arxiv-2406-02715.creator: Tamara Evstafyeva, Ulrich Sperhake, Isobel M. Romero-Shaw, Michalis Agathos
arxiv-2406-02715.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tamara Evstafyeva, Ulrich Sperhake, Isobel M. Romero-Shaw, Michalis Agathos. Gravitational-wave signals detected to date are commonly interpreted under the paradigm that they originate from pairs of black holes or neutron stars. Here, we explore the alternative scenario of boson-star signals being present in the data stream. We perform accurate and long ( ∼ 20 \sim 20 orbits) numerical simulations of boson-star binaries and inject the resulting strain into LIGO noise.

arxiv-2406-05181.title: Cosmic Censorship in Sgr A* and M87*: Observationally Excluding Naked Singularities
arxiv-2406-05181.creator: Avery E. Broderick, Kiana Salehi
arxiv-2406-05181.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Avery E. Broderick, Kiana Salehi. The imaging of Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) and the supermassive black hole at the center of Messier 87 (M87*) by the Event Horizon Telescope constrains the location and nature of emission from these objects. Coupled with flux limits from the near-infrared through the ultraviolet, the attendant size constraints provide strong evidence for the absence of an accretion-powered photosphere, and therefore for the existence of an event horizon about an astrophysical black hole.

pmc-10598559.creator: Jiajun Zhang, Kai Feng, Zhengwen Li, Bin Yang, Binhang Yan, Kai Hong Luo
pmc-10598559.description: Synthetic fuels produced from CO2 show promise in combating climate change. The reverse water gas shift (RWGS) reaction is the key to opening the CO2 molecule, and CO serves as a versatile intermediate for creating various hydrocarbons. Mo-based catalysts are of great interest for RWGS reactions featured for their stability and strong metal–oxygen interactions.

pmc-12629453.title: Beyond borders: Exploring the challenges of refugee children in Saudi Arabia and Turkey
pmc-12629453.creator: Thoraya A. bin Kadasah, Ghadah S. Alsedrani, Magdalena Szaflarski, Magdalena Szaflarski, Magdalena Szaflarski, Magdalena Szaflarski
pmc-12629453.description: The number of displaced individuals worldwide is increasing due to revolutions, wars, and economic crises. However, research on the educational, social, and cultural challenges facing refugee children is limited. Thus, this study aimed to investigate these challenges in Saudi Arabia and Turkey by focusing on refugee children’s adaptation to new cultural and social norms.

pmc-12971686.creator: Xiumei Zhu, Wanquan Cheng
pmc-12971686.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMyofascial Pain Syndrome (MPS) is a common chronic pain disorder, and there are significant individual differences in its clinical efficacy. pmc-13294140.title: Climate-induced vulnerability and health outcomes in urban Bangladesh: the mediating role of psychological stress
pmc-13294140.creator: Yu Xunda, Konstantin Moskalenko, Mohammad Anisur Rahaman, Natalia Taranova, Md. Rakibul Islam
pmc-13294140.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13603416.title: Transcriptomic Analysis of Hemolymph in Pollen-Foraging and Non-Pollen-Foraging Apis mellifera ligustica and Identification of Candidate Genes
pmc-13603416.creator: Chang Song, Lina Guo, Yuan Guo
pmc-13603416.description: Simple SummaryHoney bees are critical pollinators for farm crops and wild plants. Flying out to collect pollen costs bees large amounts of energy, and this hard work may change their internal physiological state. In this study, we compared circulating body fluid (hemolymph) from worker bees that returned with pollen and bees that came back without pollen.

pmc-13613035.title: Reconstruction of a chronic gastrocnemius tendon rupture using ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) suture tape and flexor digitorum lateralis augmentation in a dog
pmc-13613035.creator: Yebin RYU, Hwi-Yool KIM, Yongsun KIM
pmc-13613035.description: A 5-year-old Poodle presented with a plantigrade stance three weeks after traumatic gastrocnemius tendon rupture. Surgical exploration confirmed a complete rupture; following debridement and tenorrhaphy, a 20 mm defect remained. This gap was bridged using a double-layer ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) suture tape and augmented with flexor digitorum lateralis (FDL) transposition.
